txt: He chuckles. "Doesn't mean Harry isn't givin' it a good try, though."
The tall ginger on his right still has tears of laughter in his eyes. "Yeah, Mack's right, that was some gnarly shit there..."
The tall ginger on his right still has tears of laughter in his eyes. "Yeah, Mack's right, this was some gnarly shit there. I mean, before he started begging for money -- it was... "
"... new heights even for Captain Sober!"
"... that hobo in front of the Frittte? Hahaha!"
"Again? Man, I tell that one at least once a month. It's not that interesting," Chester replies.
"Ask him to describe it! His gun! Not his *fun*, just the gun will do..." He laughs.
"Ask him... Ask him to check his hand -- the one without a wine bottle -- I bet that's where his badge is!"
"Ask him..." The speaker succumbs to laughter. "Ask him to check his hand -- the one without a wine bottle -- I bet that's where his badge is!"
"Damn, I don't know. Even a real *bröderbund* like that can't survive everything..."
"Detective Mullen has done it again! 'Uh... where's my gun?'" the speaker crudely mimics your voice.
"Fuck me! Mack, come here, you've got to hear this! Dick Mullen lost his badge!"
"Fucking... I'm not dead, it just hurts, okay?"
"Good fucking god, Mack. What is that smell?"
"Hey, if you wanna dress that up, I think there's still that old bottle of mustard logged in evidence..." He's already laughing at his own joke-in-progress.
"I'm the goddamned Hjelmdallermann! Yeah, tell him I hail from the north!" His laughter is high-pitched and joyous, almost childlike.
"It's not like that. They're what is called *hetero-sexual life partners*. They have a battle-tested relationship. A 'bröderbund', if you will."
"It's not like that. They're what you call *hetero-sexual life partners*. They have a battle-tested relationship. A 'bröderbund', if you will."
"It's officer Dick Mullen from the bestseller 'Dick Mullen and the Lost Identity,'" he says fighting off laughter.
"It's officer Dick...." he tries to speak through laughter, "... Mullen from the bestseller 'Dick Mullen and the Lost Identity.'"
"Like, *really* hobocopped? Nah, that stuff's just an urban myth, Headless FALN Rider-level stuff..."
"Mack can face the Giant of Koko Nur by himself, but Disco here made him piss his pants!"

"Mack, they're *hetero-sexual life partners*. It's not like that," his partner smirks. "But yeah. There's trouble in paradise for that duo, Tequila Sunset has..." The sound of the rain grows so loud it drowns out his voice.
"Mullen dicked us..."
"Mullen's drunk and emotionally aggressive. That's new."
"Now you got to ask yourself, Mack. Are you desperate enough for *hobo mustard*?"
"Supercop here lost his badge!"
"Sure her vanilla waffles were the only thing he ate?"
"That would be *irresponsible*."
"That would have been irresponsible."
"Who lost his badge?"
"Yeah, I could see it. He's always been weird about money stuff."
"Yeah, Mack's right, that was some gnarly shit there..."
"Yeah, Mack's right, this was some gnarly shit there. I mean, before he started begging for money -- it was..."

"Yeah, sure came close," Chester mutters in return, then turns to the rapt listener. "Alright, so I was tailing this guy called 'Francis the Shoe'..." The inside of the motor carriage is thick with cigarette smoke. Outside, it starts to rain...
"You mean, like, is he out there right now, sleeping in a storm drain, chasin' down rats for leads?"
